reply: Thank you for explaining that you have asked for the full history of your mortgage since 2004, including transfers and how each payment was applied, and have not received it. We understand why you want these records. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written request for information to the servicer's designated address listing the documents you need, and keep proof of delivery. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you want records about a financial instrument you sent to settle your mortgage, which the credit union previously said was not valid. We understand you want a full account of what happened to it. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written request for information to the servicer's designated address, and keep copies of what you send. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your insurer will not pay for repairs to your home, which has dampness and mold while children live there. We understand how worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team, including any insurance funds involved. Please ask the insurer in writing for its decision and reasons, and keep photos of the damage. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your servicer failed to pay $7,300.00 in property taxes, then used your current escrow to fix it, leaving a shortage and a higher payment. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written notice of error with the tax notice and your payment records, and ask for a corrected escrow analysis. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your loan was labeled defective because a small payment plan was left off your application, even though you paid it off and have no late payments. We understand how worrying this is for your family. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage team. Please send a written request for information about the decision and any options, and keep copies of your documents. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your home is listed for tax sale even though you pay your mortgage on time, after your loan was transferred. We understand how distressing this is. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the escrow team. Please send the tax notice with a written notice of error to the servicer right away, and keep proof of delivery. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your automatic mortgage payments were changed without your authorization, and that the earlier response did not address this. We understand why you want a clear explanation. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please ask in writing who changed the schedule and why, and confirm your preferred payment schedule in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your loan was bought by a new servicer that sent no statements and only contacted you to threaten foreclosure. We understand how alarming this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team, including the late fees. Please send a written request for your statements, payment history and the transfer notice, and keep proof of delivery. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that lender-placed insurance was added without notice and that the document said to justify it was never attached. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written request for information asking for the document and all notices about the insurance requirement, and keep copies of what you receive. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have been unable to log in to your mortgage account and have been given different reasons each time. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please keep a note of each contact, and use your statement or mail to make payments on time while access is restored. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your escrow payment was raised twice within six months without an explanation. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please ask in writing for both escrow analyses, showing the tax and insurance amounts used. Changes in taxes or insurance are common reasons for a new payment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your mortgage is reported as delinquent even though it is in a forbearance plan while your deferral application is reviewed. We understand the effect on your credit. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team. Please keep the forbearance confirmations and dispute the reporting with the credit reporting companies, including copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that, as executor of your mother's estate, you have been given changing requirements to endorse the insurance check for repairs. We understand your frustration and the extra costs this has caused. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written request for a complete list of required documents, quoting your case number. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your insurance charges rose after a claim that was never paid or repaired, and that you have no explanation of the billing. We understand the effect on your housing costs. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please ask the insurer in writing how the claim was classified, and keep your billing records and claim documents. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you sent a notice of error and request for information, and that the response did not address the specific errors or provide the records you asked for. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please keep your notices, the tracking records and the response you received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you believe late payments on your mortgage are reported inaccurately. We understand you want them reviewed. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list the months you dispute and include proof of payment for each. You can dispute with the credit reporting companies as well, and request a reinvestigation if you disagree. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your mortgage payment of $3,100.00 was drafted twice, and that the servicer says it has no record of the second draft. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please send your bank's records of both drafts with a written notice of error, and ask for the duplicate to be traced. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your new servicer says there is a prepayment penalty that was not part of your original loan. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. A prepayment penalty must be in your contract, so please check your loan documents and send a copy with a written notice of error. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were charged PMI after your balance reached 78% of the original value, and that other charges appear on your account. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written request for the full PMI and fee history, and keep copies. There are specific rules on when PMI must end. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your homeowners insurance was not paid from escrow again and that you cannot reach anyone beyond the front desk. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written notice of error with the insurance bill to the servicer's designated address, and ask your insurer about your coverage status. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your escrow analysis shows a shortage of over $2,800.00 even though your insurance rose only slightly and you no longer pay property taxes. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written notice of error asking for a recalculated analysis, and include your tax exemption and insurance renewal. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that late payments were reported during your forbearance, which was later cancelled without your authorization. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team. Please keep the forbearance agreement and proof of the $4,400.00 payment, and dispute the late payments with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your financial documents are still sent to an address linked to a contractor you say defrauded you, despite repeated requests to remove it. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written notice of error asking that the address be corrected on all systems, and ask for written confirmation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your active forbearance was not honored after your loan transfer, that inspection fees were charged and that you were asked to sign a different forbearance form. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team. Please keep the forbearance documents and your notices of error, and do not sign forms you disagree with. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after assuming your grandparents' mortgage, you can no longer access the account or statements following the transfer. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send the servicer written proof of your status on the loan and ask for access to statements and account information. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you are still waiting for an escrow refund after a double tax payment, with no update on when it will arrive. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written request for the status of the refund and a copy of your escrow history, and keep proof of when you sent it. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your HELOC payment of $1,800.00 seems to be based on the wrong balance, and that your requests for an explanation have gone unanswered. We understand your concern about your plan. Your complaint has been logged for review by the home equity team. Please send a written request for the payment calculation and the agreement terms it relies on, and keep a copy. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your autopay stopped, you receive no statements or access, and the account is now reported as 60 to 89 days late while your dispute is unanswered. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loan servicing team. Please keep your dispute letters, and ask in writing for a way to make payments and see your statements. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid a fee for a tax credit certificate that was later withdrawn because documents were not sent, and that you have received conflicting explanations. We understand your disappointment. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage team. Please ask in writing for an explanation of what happened and whether the fee was returned, and keep your receipt. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after paying $800.00 for an appraisal and providing documents, you have heard nothing about your loan application. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage team. Please ask in writing for the status of your application, a copy of the appraisal and your Loan Estimate, and keep proof of your payment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
